input.command:
set -eu
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
BASE="/tmp/opdbus-netmk-baseline-$STAMP"
sudo install -d -m 0700 "$BASE"
body=$(sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
[ "$pid" -gt 0 ]
printf '%s\n' "$STAMP" | sudo tee "$BASE/timestamp" >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$body" | sudo tee "$BASE/NetMaker-state.json" >/dev/null
sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker?recursion=1' > /tmp/netmk-instance.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-instance.$$ "$BASE/NetMaker-instance.json"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-instance.$$
sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/snapshots?recursion=1' > /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$ "$BASE/NetMaker-snapshots.json"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$
sudo sh -c "tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$pid/cmdline >'$BASE/init-cmdline'; printf '\n' >>'$BASE/init-cmdline'"
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -p -- ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,args --sort=pid > /tmp/netmk-processes.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-processes.$$ "$BASE/processes.txt"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-processes.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ip -details addr show > /tmp/netmk-addr.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-addr.$$ "$BASE/net-addresses.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-addr.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ip -4 route show table all > /tmp/netmk-routes.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-routes.$$ "$BASE/net-routes.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-routes.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ss -lntup > /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$ "$BASE/listeners.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$
sudo find "/proc/$pid/root/etc/systemd/system" -maxdepth 3 -type l -printf '%P -> %l\n' 2>/dev/null | sudo tee "$BASE/enabled-unit-links.txt" >/dev/null
for unit in netmaker.service emqx.service grafana-server.service prometheus.service rust-network-mgr.service netclient.service rsyslog.service cron.service systemd-resolved.service dbus.service; do
  found=
  for d in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system; do
    p="/proc/$pid/root$d/$unit"
    if sudo test -f "$p"; then
      found=$p
      printf '%s\n' "[$unit] path=${p#/proc/$pid/root}" | sudo tee -a "$BASE/unit-summary.txt" >/dev/null
      sudo awk '
        /^(ExecStart|ExecStartPre|ExecStop|User|Group|WorkingDirectory|PIDFile|Type|Restart|After|Requires|Wants)=/ {print}
        /^EnvironmentFile=/ {print}
        /^Environment=/ {line=$0; sub(/=.*/,"=<redacted>",line); print line}
      ' "$p" | sudo tee -a "$BASE/unit-summary.txt" >/dev/null

tool.tool_use_purpose: Capture a secure read-only rollback inventory of the production NetMaker container, services, listeners, configuration metadata, network state, and immutable wgcf baseline.

ExecuteCmd.command:
set -eu
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
BASE="/tmp/opdbus-netmk-baseline-$STAMP"
sudo install -d -m 0700 "$BASE"
body=$(sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
[ "$pid" -gt 0 ]
printf '%s\n' "$STAMP" | sudo tee "$BASE/timestamp" >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$body" | sudo tee "$BASE/NetMaker-state.json" >/dev/null
sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker?recursion=1' > /tmp/netmk-instance.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-instance.$$ "$BASE/NetMaker-instance.json"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-instance.$$
sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/snapshots?recursion=1' > /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$ "$BASE/NetMaker-snapshots.json"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-snapshots.$$
sudo sh -c "tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$pid/cmdline >'$BASE/init-cmdline'; printf '\n' >>'$BASE/init-cmdline'"
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -p -- ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,args --sort=pid > /tmp/netmk-processes.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-processes.$$ "$BASE/processes.txt"
rm -f /tmp/netmk-processes.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ip -details addr show > /tmp/netmk-addr.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-addr.$$ "$BASE/net-addresses.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-addr.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ip -4 route show table all > /tmp/netmk-routes.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-routes.$$ "$BASE/net-routes.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-routes.$$
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/ss -lntup > /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$
sudo install -m 0600 /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$ "$BASE/listeners.txt"; rm -f /tmp/netmk-listeners.$$
sudo find "/proc/$pid/root/etc/systemd/system" -maxdepth 3 -type l -printf '%P -> %l\n' 2>/dev/null | sudo tee "$BASE/enabled-unit-links.txt" >/dev/null
for unit in netmaker.service emqx.service grafana-server.service prometheus.service rust-network-mgr.service netclient.service rsyslog.service cron.service systemd-resolved.service dbus.service; do
  found=
  for d in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system; do
    p="/proc/$pid/root$d/$unit"
    if sudo test -f "$p"; then
      found=$p
      printf '%s\n' "[$unit] path=${p#/proc/$pid/root}" | sudo tee -a "$BASE/unit-summary.txt" >/dev/null
      sudo awk '
        /^(ExecStart|ExecStartPre|ExecStop|User|Group|WorkingDirectory|PIDFile|Type|Restart|After|Requires|Wants)=/ {print}
        /^EnvironmentFile=/ {print}
        /^Environment=/ {line=$0; sub(/=.*/,"=<redacted>",line); print line}
      ' "$p" | sudo tee -a "$BASE/unit-summary.txt" >/dev/null
      break
    fi
  done
  [ -n "$found" ] || printf '%s\n' "[$unit] MISSING" | sudo tee -a "$BASE/unit-summary.txt" >/dev/null
done
sudo readlink "/proc/$pid/root/etc/resolv.conf" 2>/dev/null | sudo tee "$BASE/resolv-conf-target.txt" >/dev/null || true
sudo find "/proc/$pid/root/etc/netclient" -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %P\n' 2>/dev/null | sudo tee "$BASE/netclient-file-inventory.txt" >/dev/null
sudo /usr/bin/sha256sum /etc/wireguard/wgcf-egress.conf | sudo tee "$BASE/wgcf-config.sha256" >/dev/null

printf 'baseline=%s\n' "$BASE"

set -eu
body=$(sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')

for scheme in Bearer Token; do
  out=$(mktemp)

# Netclient Container Netns — Interface Contract

---

## 1 · Fixed Names and Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| OVS bridge | `ovsbr0` |
| Netmaker port | `netmk` (`type=internal`) |
| Netmaker address | `10.200.1.1/30` |
| Xray gateway address | `10.200.1.2/30` |
| Existing xray fabric address | `10.200.0.1` |
| Host fabric address/interface | `10.200.0.2`, `svc0` |
| Netclient payload mark | `0x51821/0xffffffff` |
| Existing wgcf underlay mark | `0x51820` — observe only |
| Existing policy table | `51820` — observe only |
| Netclient policy priorities | `10518` lookup, `10519` blackhole |
| Adapter UDS | `/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker/op-grpc-adapters.sock` |
| Adapter loopback | `http://127.0.0.1:50061` |
| Adapter environment | `NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR` |
| OpenFlow cookie prefix | `0x4e4d4b0000000000/0xffffff0000000000` |
| Ready directory | `/run/opdbus/runit-ready/` |

No placeholder values remain in this contract. Live peer endpoint ports and
container init PIDs are intentionally discovered values.

---

## 2 · Namespace and OVS Contract

### `netmk`

```text
Bridge:          ovsbr0
Port name:       netmk
OVS type:        internal
Namespace:       current netmaker init PID
Address:         10.200.1.1/30
State:           UP
Default route:   via 10.200.1.2 dev netmk
```

### Xray gateway, Phase 1

```text
Interface:       discover current OVS-facing interface (expected eth0)
Namespace:       current xray init PID
Existing IP:     10.200.0.1
Added IP:        10.200.1.2/30
Forwarding:      net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
Redirects:       net.ipv4.conf.<inside>.send_redirects=0
Host next hop:   10.200.0.2
```

### Host return route

```text
10.200.1.0/30 via 10.200.0.1 dev svc0
```

### Mutation invariants

- Create `netmk` through `rovs_commands.add_port` with
  `interface_type="internal"`; runtime dispatch must honor the field.
- Move it with `RTM_NEWLINK` + `IFLA_NET_NS_PID`.
- Configure addresses, state, and routes through rtnetlink.
- Do not address the `ovsbr0` bridge device.
- Preserve all pre-existing xray interface properties.
- Resolve fresh Incus init PIDs on every reconciliation.
- Execute target-netns operations on a dedicated OS thread. Enter netns, create
  the netlink socket there, perform all operations, restore/terminate, and only
  then return to async code.

---

## 3 · Existing wgcf Dependency Contract

```text
Namespace:          host
Interface:          wgcf-egress
Configuration:      /etc/wireguard/wgcf-egress.conf
Underlay FwMark:    0x51820 — external
Policy table:       51820 — external routes
Integration mark:   0x51821 — feature-owned priority-10518 rule
Ownership boundary: interface/config/table/lifecycle external; integration rule local
```

This feature may read interface state, latest handshake, existing rules, and
table routes. It must not:

- write the configuration file;
- invoke interface up/down;
- create/delete `wgcf-egress`;
- modify underlay mark `0x51820`;
- add, delete, flush, or replace routes in table `51820`;
- restart or reconfigure the owning service.

Missing prerequisite state is a readiness failure with an actionable message;
it is not repaired by this feature.

---

## 4 · Forced Egress Contract

### Packet path

```text
netclient peer UDP
  → netmk 10.200.1.1
  → default gateway 10.200.1.2 (xray)
  → xray L3 forward, same OVS-facing interface
  → xray existing next hop 10.200.0.2
  → host svc0 PREROUTING
  → mark 0x51821
  → existing table 51820
  → wgcf-egress
  → Internet
```

Return traffic is reverse-translated on the host, routed through
`10.200.1.0/30 via 10.200.0.1 dev svc0`, forwarded by xray, and delivered by
OVS to `netmk`.

### Xray-owned integration chain

Dedicated chain: `OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD` in filter table.

Logical rules, with one outbound rule per discovered peer endpoint port:

```text
FORWARD jumps:
  -i <inside> -s 10.200.1.1/32 -j OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD
  -i <inside> -d 10.200.1.1/32 -j OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD

OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD:
  -i <inside> -o <inside> -s 10.200.1.1/32 -p udp --dport <peer-port> -j ACCEPT
  -i <inside> -o <inside> -d 10.200.1.1/32 -m conntrack \
      --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```

# Netclient Container Netns — Interface Contract

---

## 1 · Fixed Names and Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| OVS bridge | `ovsbr0` |
| Netmaker port | `netmk` (`type=internal`) |
| Netmaker address | `10.200.1.1/30` |
| Xray gateway address | `10.200.1.2/30` |
| Existing xray fabric address | `10.200.0.1` |
| Host fabric address/interface | `10.200.0.2`, `svc0` |
| Netclient payload mark | `0x51821/0xffffffff` |
| Existing wgcf underlay mark | `0x51820` — observe only |
| Existing policy table | `51820` — observe only |
| Netclient policy priorities | `10518` lookup, `10519` blackhole |
| Adapter UDS | `/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker/op-grpc-adapters.sock` |
| Adapter loopback | `http://127.0.0.1:50061` |
| Adapter environment | `NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR` |
| OpenFlow cookie prefix | `0x4e4d4b0000000000/0xffffff0000000000` |
| Ready directory | `/run/opdbus/runit-ready/` |

No placeholder values remain in this contract. Live peer endpoint ports and
container init PIDs are intentionally discovered values.

---

## 2 · Namespace and OVS Contract

### `netmk`

```text
Bridge:          ovsbr0
Port name:       netmk
OVS type:        internal
Namespace:       current netmaker init PID
Address:         10.200.1.1/30
State:           UP
Default route:   via 10.200.1.2 dev netmk
```

### Xray gateway, Phase 1

```text
Interface:       discover current OVS-facing interface (expected eth0)
Namespace:       current xray init PID
Existing IP:     10.200.0.1
Added IP:        10.200.1.2/30
Forwarding:      net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
Redirects:       net.ipv4.conf.<inside>.send_redirects=0
Host next hop:   10.200.0.2
```

### Host return route

```text
10.200.1.0/30 via 10.200.0.1 dev svc0
```

### Mutation invariants

- Create `netmk` through `rovs_commands.add_port` with
  `interface_type="internal"`; runtime dispatch must honor the field.
- Move it with `RTM_NEWLINK` + `IFLA_NET_NS_PID`.
- Configure addresses, state, and routes through rtnetlink.
- Do not address the `ovsbr0` bridge device.
- Preserve all pre-existing xray interface properties.
- Resolve fresh Incus init PIDs on every reconciliation.
- Execute target-netns operations on a dedicated OS thread. Enter netns, create
  the netlink socket there, perform all operations, restore/terminate, and only
  then return to async code.

---

## 3 · Existing wgcf Dependency Contract

```text
Namespace:          host
Interface:          wgcf-egress
Configuration:      /etc/wireguard/wgcf-egress.conf
Underlay FwMark:    0x51820 — external
Policy table:       51820 — external routes
Integration mark:   0x51821 — feature-owned priority-10518 rule
Ownership boundary: interface/config/table/lifecycle external; integration rule local
```

This feature may read interface state, latest handshake, existing rules, and
table routes. It must not:

- write the configuration file;
- invoke interface up/down;
- create/delete `wgcf-egress`;
- modify underlay mark `0x51820`;
- add, delete, flush, or replace routes in table `51820`;
- restart or reconfigure the owning service.

Missing prerequisite state is a readiness failure with an actionable message;
it is not repaired by this feature.

---

## 4 · Forced Egress Contract

### Packet path

```text
netclient peer UDP
  → netmk 10.200.1.1
  → default gateway 10.200.1.2 (xray)
  → xray L3 forward, same OVS-facing interface
  → xray existing next hop 10.200.0.2
  → host svc0 PREROUTING
  → mark 0x51821
  → existing table 51820
  → wgcf-egress
  → Internet
```

Return traffic is reverse-translated on the host, routed through
`10.200.1.0/30 via 10.200.0.1 dev svc0`, forwarded by xray, and delivered by
OVS to `netmk`.

Dedicated chain: `OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD` in filter table.

```text
OP_NETMK_XRAY_FWD:
  -i <inside> -o <inside> -s 10.200.1.1/32 -p udp --dport <peer-port> -j ACCEPT
```

input.__tool_use_purpose: Verify that the discovered persistent Netmaker environment file can reproduce the running process environment, without printing secret values.
input.command:
set -eu
NMPID=$(pgrep -f '^/usr/local/bin/netmaker -c /etc/netmaker/config.yaml$' | head -n1)
ENVFILE="/proc/$NMPID/root/etc/netmaker/netmaker.env"
sudo stat -c 'envfile=%n mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g size=%s mtime=%y' "$ENVFILE"
printf '%s\n' '=== persistent environment key names only ==='
sudo awk -F= '/^(export[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/{k=$1; sub(/^export[[:space:]]+/,"",k); print k}' "$ENVFILE" | sort
TMP_CUR=$(mktemp); TMP_FILE=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP_CUR" "$TMP_FILE"' EXIT
sudo sh -c "tr '\0' '\n' </proc/$NMPID/environ" >"$TMP_CUR"
sudo cat "$ENVFILE" >"$TMP_FILE"
python3 - "$TMP_CUR" "$TMP_FILE" <<'PY'
import shlex,sys
cur={}
for line in open(sys.argv[1], errors='replace'):
    if '=' in line:
        k,v=line.rstrip('\n').split('=',1); cur[k]=v
persist={}
for raw in open(sys.argv[2], errors='replace'):
    line=raw.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'): continue
    if line.startswith('export '): line=line[7:].lstrip()
    if '=' not in line: continue
    k,v=line.split('=',1)
    try:
        vals=shlex.split(v, posix=True); v=vals[0] if vals else ''
    except ValueError: pass
    persist[k.strip()]=v
keys=['LICENSE_KEY','MASTER_KEY','NETMAKER_TENANT_ID','SERVER_API_CONN_STRING','SERVER_HTTP_HOST','SERVER_HOST','SERVER_NAME','DATABASE','SQLITE','REST_BACKEND']
for k in keys:
    state='missing_both' if k not in cur and k not in persist else 'missing_persistent' if k not in persist else 'missing_running' if k not in cur else 'equal' if cur[k]==persist[k] else 'different'
    print(f'{k}={state}')
PY
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTENT_ENV_REPRODUCIBILITY_CHECK_COMPLETE'

input.__tool_use_purpose: Determine whether existing Netclient configuration contains usable enrollment, WireGuard ports, or peer state needed for Phase 1 without exposing keys or tokens.
input.command:
set -eu
body=$(sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
ROOT="/proc/$pid/root"
printf '%s\n' '=== netclient config structure ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json servers.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  echo "-- $f"
  sudo jq -c 'if type=="object" then {keys:(keys|sort), scalar_types:with_entries(select(.value|type != "object" and type != "array") | .value=(.value|type))} elif type=="array" then {type:"array",length:length} else {type:type} end' "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== port-like numeric fields only ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json servers.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  sudo jq -r --arg f "$f" 'paths(scalars) as $p | select(($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("port|listen"))) | getpath($p) as $v | select(($v|type)=="number" or (($v|type)=="string" and ($v|test("^[0-9]+$")))) | "\($f):\($p|map(tostring)|join("."))=\($v)"' "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== safe enrollment indicators ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  sudo jq -r --arg f "$f" 'paths(scalars) as $p | select(($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("enabled|connected|network|interface|server"))) | getpath($p) as $v | select(($v|type)=="boolean" or ($v|type)=="number" or (($v|type)=="string" and (($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("key|token|secret|password"))|not))) | "\($f):\($p|map(tostring)|join("."))=\($v)"' "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -100 || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== netclient list (read-only) ==='
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -n -- /usr/local/bin/netclient list 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== current WireGuard in namespace ==='
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all listen-port 2>&1 || true
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all endpoints 2>&1 || true
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'NETCLIENT_READ_ONLY_STATE_COMPLETE'

body=$(sudo /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
ROOT="/proc/$pid/root"
printf '%s\n' '=== netclient config structure ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json servers.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  echo "-- $f"
  sudo jq -c 'if type=="object" then {keys:(keys|sort), scalar_types:with_entries(select(.value|type != "object" and type != "array") | .value=(.value|type))} elif type=="array" then {type:"array",length:length} else {type:type} end' "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== port-like numeric fields only ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json servers.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  sudo jq -r --arg f "$f" 'paths(scalars) as $p | select(($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("port|listen"))) | getpath($p) as $v | select(($v|type)=="number" or (($v|type)=="string" and ($v|test("^[0-9]+$")))) | "\($f):\($p|map(tostring)|join("."))=\($v)"' "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== safe enrollment indicators ==='
for f in netclient.json nodes.json; do
  p="$ROOT/etc/netclient/$f"
  sudo jq -r --arg f "$f" 'paths(scalars) as $p | select(($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("enabled|connected|network|interface|server"))) | getpath($p) as $v | select(($v|type)=="boolean" or ($v|type)=="number" or (($v|type)=="string" and (($p[-1]|tostring|ascii_downcase|test("key|token|secret|password"))|not))) | "\($f):\($p|map(tostring)|join("."))=\($v)"' "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -100 || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== netclient list (read-only) ==='
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -n -- /usr/local/bin/netclient list 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== current WireGuard in namespace ==='
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all listen-port 2>&1 || true
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all endpoints 2>&1 || true
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -n -- /usr/bin/wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'NETCLIENT_READ_ONLY_STATE_COMPLETE'

input.__tool_use_purpose: Collect non-secret service command and environment-shape details needed to reproduce the current NetMaker services under runit.
input.command:
set -eu
body=$(sudo curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
ROOT="/proc/$pid/root"
printf '%s\n' '=== full non-secret unit command lines ==='
for u in /etc/systemd/system/emqx.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/grafana-server.service /etc/systemd/system/prometheus.service /etc/systemd/system/rust-network-mgr.service; do
  echo "-- $u"
  sudo awk '
    /^ExecStart=/ {show=1}
    show {print; if ($0 !~ /\\$/) show=0}
    /^(WorkingDirectory|User|Group)=/ {print}
  ' "$ROOT$u" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== EMQX inline environment key names and safe topology values ==='
sudo awk -F= '/^Environment=/{line=$0; sub(/^Environment=/,"",line); gsub(/^"|"$/,"",line); split(line,a,"="); if (a[1] ~ /COOKIE|KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD/) print a[1]"=<redacted>"; else print line}' "$ROOT/etc/systemd/system/emqx.service"
printf '%s\n' '=== default-file key names ==='
for f in /etc/default/grafana-server /etc/default/cron; do echo "-- $f"; sudo awk -F= '/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/{print $1}' "$ROOT$f" 2>/dev/null | sort; done
printf '%s\n' '=== rust-network-mgr environment relationships ==='
RMPID=$(pgrep -f '^/usr/local/bin/rust-network-mgr$' | head -n1)
TMP=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
sudo sh -c "tr '\0' '\n' </proc/$RMPID/environ" >"$TMP"
awk -F= '{print $1}' "$TMP" | sort
python3 - "$TMP" "$ROOT/etc/netmaker/netmaker.env" <<'PY'
import shlex,sys
cur={}
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    if '=' in line:
        k,v=line.rstrip('\n').split('=',1); cur[k]=v
p={}
for raw in open(sys.argv[2]):
    line=raw.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in line: continue
    if line.startswith('export '): line=line[7:].lstrip()
    k,v=line.split('=',1)
    try:
      vals=shlex.split(v); v=vals[0] if vals else ''
    except: pass
    p[k.strip()]=v
for rk in sorted(cur):
    if any(x in rk for x in ('KEY','TOKEN','SECRET','PASSWORD')):
        matches=[pk for pk,pv in p.items() if pv==cur[rk]]
        print(f'{rk}=matches_persistent:{",".join(matches) if matches else "no"}')
PY
printf '%s\n' '=== init mount compatibility ==='
printf 'container_loader='; sudo test -e "$ROOT/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'container_glibc='; sudo chroot "$ROOT" /usr/bin/ldd --version | head -1
for b in runsvdir runsv sv chpst; do printf '%s_required_glibc=' "$b"; objdump -T "/usr/bin/$b" 2>/dev/null | awk '/GLIBC_[0-9]/{gsub(/[()]/,"",$5); print $5}' | sort -V | tail -1; done
printf '%s\n' 'SERVICE_TRANSLATION_INPUT_COMPLETE'

CXXFLAGS=\"-include cstdint\" cargo build --workspace --release"

BINARIES=$(find "$RELEASE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable ! -name '*.d' ! -name '*.so' | sort)
[ -n "$BINARIES" ] || die "$RELEASE_DIR contains no executables"
BIN_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | wc -l)
log "$BIN_COUNT release binaries in $RELEASE_DIR"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ] && [ "$(id -u)" != 0 ]; then
    die "must run as root (subvolume creation and install to $INSTALL_BIN)"
fi

COMMIT=$(git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
STAMP=$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

# ═══ Path 1: golden subvolume ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
build_golden() {
    log "building golden subvolume at $GOLDEN_DIR"

    # /opt must be btrfs for subvolumes; refuse rather than silently making a
    # plain directory that cannot be snapshotted or sent.
    fstype=$(stat -f -c %T "$OPDBUS_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || stat -f -c %T "$(dirname "$OPDBUS_ROOT")")
    case "$fstype" in
        btrfs) ;;
        *) die "$OPDBUS_ROOT is on '$fstype', not btrfs — snapshots and send need btrfs" ;;
    esac

    run mkdir -p "$OPDBUS_ROOT"

    if [ ! -d "$GOLDEN_DIR" ]; then
        run btrfs subvolume create "$GOLDEN_DIR"
        ok "created subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    else
        log "reusing existing subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    fi

    run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv" "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc"

    # Binaries
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin/$(basename "$bin")"
    done
    ok "staged $BIN_COUNT binaries into golden/bin"

    # Control scripts + the systemd compatibility layer.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units systemctl-shim \
                  build-golden.sh; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/agent-runit-guard.sh"
    ok "staged control scripts into golden/sbin"

    # Runit service definitions tracked in the repo.
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc"
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/log/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}finish" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}finish" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/finish"
    done
    ok "staged runit service definitions into golden/sv"

    # Config the target needs alongside the binaries.
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/environment.default"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-agent-runit-guard.hook"

    # MANIFEST: what this snapshot is, and the hashes to prove the running host
    # matches it.
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
        {
            printf 'golden-build: %s\n' "$STAMP"
            printf 'commit: %s\n' "$COMMIT"
            printf 'source: %s\n' "$PROJECT_ROOT"
            printf 'init: runit (sv)\n'
            printf 'binaries: %s\n' "$BIN_COUNT"
            printf '\n[sha256]\n'
            printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
                printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "$bin" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(basename "$bin")"
            done
        } > "$GOLDEN_DIR/MANIFEST"
    fi
    ok "wrote golden/MANIFEST (commit $COMMIT)"
    log "golden is ready; the read-only snapshot and btrfs send happen at deploy time"
}

# ═══ Path 2: live runtime ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Services that are never auto-restarted: they carry the host's network and
# session bus, and bouncing them from a deploy script can cut remote access or
# reparent the control plane. They are reported so an operator can restart them
# deliberately, on the console, in a chosen order.
NEVER_AUTO_RESTART="ovs-vswitchd ovsbr0-addr ovsbr0-svc-addr ovsbr0-uplink \
uplink-dhcp op-session-bus opdbus-rundirs dbus"

# Which enabled services actually exec a given binary?
#
# Matches the installed path with a trailing word boundary, not the bare name:
# a substring match would tie `opdbus` to `opdbus-rundirs` and drag unrelated
# services into the restart set.
services_using() {
    binary=$1
    # `.` is the only ERE metacharacter in these paths.
    escaped=$(printf '%s' "$INSTALL_BIN/$binary" | sed 's/\./\\./g')
    for link in "$RUNIT_RUNSVDIR"/*; do
        [ -e "$link" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$link")
        run_script="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        [ -f "$run_script" ] || continue
        if grep -qE "${escaped}([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|\$)" "$run_script" 2>/dev/null; then
            printf '%s\n' "$svc"
        fi
    done
}

install_live() {
    log "installing into the live runtime"

    changed_binaries=""
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        name=$(basename "$bin")
        target="$INSTALL_BIN/$name"
        if [ -f "$target" ] && cmp -s "$bin" "$target"; then
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$target"
        printf '%s\n' "$name" >> /tmp/golden-changed.$$
    done
    [ -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$" ] && changed_binaries=$(cat "/tmp/golden-changed.$$")
    rm -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$"

    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        ok "all $BIN_COUNT binaries already current in $INSTALL_BIN"
    else
        ok "updated $(printf '%s\n' "$changed_binaries" | wc -l) binaries in $INSTALL_BIN"
    fi

    # Control scripts. The systemctl shim goes in $INSTALL_BIN because sudo's
    # secure_path searches it before /usr/bin, so it wins for installers.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$INSTALL_SBIN/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" "$INSTALL_BIN/systemctl"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$INSTALL_SBIN/agent-runit-guard"
    ok "installed control scripts + systemd compat layer"

    if [ -d /etc/pacman.d/hooks ] || mkdir -p /etc/pacman.d/hooks 2>/dev/null; then
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
            run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
                /etc/pacman.d/hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook
    fi

    # Service definitions: install new ones, never clobber a hand-tuned run
    # script that differs (the host copy is authoritative until an operator says
    # otherwise).
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        dest="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        if [ -f "$dest" ] && ! cmp -s "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"; then
            warn "$dest differs from the repo copy — leaving the host version alone"
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/log/run"
    done

    if [ "$DO_RESTART" != 1 ]; then
        warn "--no-restart: services still running the previous binaries"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        log "nothing changed; no restarts needed"
        return 0
    fi

    # Restart only services whose binary actually changed.
    restart_list=""
    held_back=""
    for name in $changed_binaries; do
        for svc in $(services_using "$name"); do
            # Network and session-bus carriers are reported, never bounced here.
            case " $NEVER_AUTO_RESTART " in
                *" $svc "*)
                    case " $held_back " in
                        *" $svc "*) ;;
                        *) held_back="$held_back $svc" ;;
                    esac
                    continue
                    ;;
            esac
            case " $restart_list " in
                *" $svc "*) ;;
                *) restart_list="$restart_list $svc" ;;
            esac
        done
    done

    if [ -n "$held_back" ]; then
        warn "NOT restarted (network/session-bus critical):$held_back"
        warn "  restart these deliberately from the console, e.g.: sudo sv restart <svc>"
    fi

    if [ -z "$restart_list" ]; then
        log "no enabled service references the changed binaries"
        return 0
    fi

    log "restarting:$restart_list"
    for svc in $restart_list; do
        run sv restart "$svc" || warn "sv restart $svc failed"
    done

    # Report real state rather than assuming the restart worked.
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
        sleep 3
        for svc in $restart_list; do
            printf '  %s\n' "$(sv status "$svc" 2>&1 | head -1)"
        done
    fi
}

# ═══ Run ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[ "$DO_GOLDEN" = 1 ] && build_golden
[ "$DO_LIVE" = 1 ] && install_live

log "commit $COMMIT, build $STAMP"
[ "$DO_GOLDEN" = 1 ] && log "deployable subvolume: $GOLDEN_DIR"
[ "$DO_LIVE" = 1 ] && log "live runtime: $INSTALL_BIN"
ok "done"

python3 - "$TMP" "$ROOT/etc/netmaker/netmaker.env" <<'PY'
import shlex,sys
cur={}
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    if '=' in line:
        k,v=line.rstrip('\n').split('=',1); cur[k]=v
p={}
for raw in open(sys.argv[2]):
    line=raw.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in line: continue
    if line.startswith('export '): line=line[7:].lstrip()
    k,v=line.split('=',1)
    try:
      vals=shlex.split(v); v=vals[0] if vals else ''
    except: pass
    p[k.strip()]=v
for rk in sorted(cur):

PY

CXXFLAGS=\"-include cstdint\" cargo build --workspace --release"

BINARIES=$(find "$RELEASE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable ! -name '*.d' ! -name '*.so' | sort)
[ -n "$BINARIES" ] || die "$RELEASE_DIR contains no executables"
BIN_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | wc -l)
log "$BIN_COUNT release binaries in $RELEASE_DIR"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ] && [ "$(id -u)" != 0 ]; then
    die "must run as root (subvolume creation and install to $INSTALL_BIN)"
fi

COMMIT=$(git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
STAMP=$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

# ═══ Path 1: golden subvolume ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
build_golden() {
    log "building golden subvolume at $GOLDEN_DIR"

    # /opt must be btrfs for subvolumes; refuse rather than silently making a
    # plain directory that cannot be snapshotted or sent.
    fstype=$(stat -f -c %T "$OPDBUS_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || stat -f -c %T "$(dirname "$OPDBUS_ROOT")")
    case "$fstype" in
        btrfs) ;;
        *) die "$OPDBUS_ROOT is on '$fstype', not btrfs — snapshots and send need btrfs" ;;
    esac

    run mkdir -p "$OPDBUS_ROOT"

    if [ ! -d "$GOLDEN_DIR" ]; then
        run btrfs subvolume create "$GOLDEN_DIR"
        ok "created subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    else
        log "reusing existing subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    fi

    run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv" "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc"

    # Binaries
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin/$(basename "$bin")"
    done
    ok "staged $BIN_COUNT binaries into golden/bin"

    # Control scripts + the systemd compatibility layer.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units systemctl-shim \
                  build-golden.sh; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/agent-runit-guard.sh"
    ok "staged control scripts into golden/sbin"

    # Runit service definitions tracked in the repo.
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc"
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/log/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}finish" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}finish" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/finish"
    done
    ok "staged runit service definitions into golden/sv"

    # Config the target needs alongside the binaries.
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/environment.default"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-agent-runit-guard.hook"

    # MANIFEST: what this snapshot is, and the hashes to prove the running host
    # matches it.
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
        {
            printf 'golden-build: %s\n' "$STAMP"
            printf 'commit: %s\n' "$COMMIT"
            printf 'source: %s\n' "$PROJECT_ROOT"
            printf 'init: runit (sv)\n'
            printf 'binaries: %s\n' "$BIN_COUNT"
            printf '\n[sha256]\n'
            printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
                printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "$bin" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(basename "$bin")"
            done
        } > "$GOLDEN_DIR/MANIFEST"
    fi
    ok "wrote golden/MANIFEST (commit $COMMIT)"
    log "golden is ready; the read-only snapshot and btrfs send happen at deploy time"
}

# ═══ Path 2: live runtime ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Services that are never auto-restarted: they carry the host's network and
# session bus, and bouncing them from a deploy script can cut remote access or
# reparent the control plane. They are reported so an operator can restart them
# deliberately, on the console, in a chosen order.
NEVER_AUTO_RESTART="ovs-vswitchd ovsbr0-addr ovsbr0-svc-addr ovsbr0-uplink \
uplink-dhcp op-session-bus opdbus-rundirs dbus"

# Which enabled services actually exec a given binary?
#
# Matches the installed path with a trailing word boundary, not the bare name:
# a substring match would tie `opdbus` to `opdbus-rundirs` and drag unrelated
# services into the restart set.
services_using() {
    binary=$1
    # `.` is the only ERE metacharacter in these paths.
    escaped=$(printf '%s' "$INSTALL_BIN/$binary" | sed 's/\./\\./g')
    for link in "$RUNIT_RUNSVDIR"/*; do
        [ -e "$link" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$link")
        run_script="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        [ -f "$run_script" ] || continue
        if grep -qE "${escaped}([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|\$)" "$run_script" 2>/dev/null; then
            printf '%s\n' "$svc"
        fi
    done
}

install_live() {
    log "installing into the live runtime"

    changed_binaries=""
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        name=$(basename "$bin")
        target="$INSTALL_BIN/$name"
        if [ -f "$target" ] && cmp -s "$bin" "$target"; then
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$target"
        printf '%s\n' "$name" >> /tmp/golden-changed.$$
    done
    [ -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$" ] && changed_binaries=$(cat "/tmp/golden-changed.$$")
    rm -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$"

    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        ok "all $BIN_COUNT binaries already current in $INSTALL_BIN"
    else
        ok "updated $(printf '%s\n' "$changed_binaries" | wc -l) binaries in $INSTALL_BIN"
    fi

    # Control scripts. The systemctl shim goes in $INSTALL_BIN because sudo's
    # secure_path searches it before /usr/bin, so it wins for installers.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$INSTALL_SBIN/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" "$INSTALL_BIN/systemctl"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$INSTALL_SBIN/agent-runit-guard"
    ok "installed control scripts + systemd compat layer"

    if [ -d /etc/pacman.d/hooks ] || mkdir -p /etc/pacman.d/hooks 2>/dev/null; then
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
            run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
                /etc/pacman.d/hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook
    fi

    # Service definitions: install new ones, never clobber a hand-tuned run
    # script that differs (the host copy is authoritative until an operator says
    # otherwise).
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        dest="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        if [ -f "$dest" ] && ! cmp -s "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"; then
            warn "$dest differs from the repo copy — leaving the host version alone"
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/log/run"
    done

    if [ "$DO_RESTART" != 1 ]; then
        warn "--no-restart: services still running the previous binaries"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        log "nothing changed; no restarts needed"
        return 0
    fi

    # Restart only services whose binary actually changed.
    restart_list=""
    held_back=""
    for name in $changed_binaries; do
        for svc in $(services_using "$name"); do
            # Network and session-bus carriers are reported, never bounced here.
            case " $NEVER_AUTO_RESTART " in
                *" $svc "*)
                    case " $held_back " in
                        *" $svc "*) ;;
                        *) held_back="$held_back $svc" ;;
                    esac
                    continue
                    ;;
            esac
            case " $restart_list " in
                *" $svc "*) ;;
                *) restart_list="$restart_list $svc" ;;
            esac
        done
    done

    if [ -n "$held_back" ]; then
        warn "NOT restarted (network/session-bus critical):$held_back"
        warn "  restart these deliberately from the console, e.g.: sudo sv restart <svc>"
    fi

    if [ -z "$restart_list" ]; then
        log "no enabled service references the changed binaries"
        return 0
    fi

    log "restarting:$restart_list"
    for svc in $restart_list; do
        run sv restart "$svc" || warn "sv restart $svc failed"
    done

    # Report real state rather than assuming the restart worked.
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
        sleep 3
        for svc in $restart_list; do
            printf '  %s\n' "$(sv status "$svc" 2>&1 | head -1)"
        done
    fi
}

# ═══ Run ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[ "$DO_GOLDEN" = 1 ] && build_golden
[ "$DO_LIVE" = 1 ] && install_live

log "commit $COMMIT, build $STAMP"
[ "$DO_GOLDEN" = 1 ] && log "deployable subvolume: $GOLDEN_DIR"
[ "$DO_LIVE" = 1 ] && log "live runtime: $INSTALL_BIN"
ok "done"

set -eu
body=$(sudo curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket /var/lib/incus/unix.socket 'http://localhost/1.0/instances/NetMaker/state')
pid=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | jq -r '.metadata.pid')
ROOT="/proc/$pid/root"
printf '%s\n' '=== rust-network-mgr unit environment ==='
sudo awk -F= '/^Environment=/{line=$0; sub(/^Environment=/,"",line); gsub(/^"|"$/,"",line); split(line,a,"="); if (a[1] ~ /KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD/) print a[1]"=<redacted>"; else print line}' "$ROOT/etc/systemd/system/rust-network-mgr.service"
printf '%s\n' '=== existing EMQX cookie source paths only ==='
sudo grep -RIl '3tched-netmaker-emqx' "$ROOT/etc" "$ROOT/opt/emqx-5.8.4-native/etc" "$ROOT/opt/emqx-5.8.4-native/data/configs" 2>/dev/null | sed "s#$ROOT##" | head -30 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== binary compatibility ==='
printf 'container_loader='; sudo test -e "$ROOT/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'container_glibc='; sudo chroot "$ROOT" /usr/bin/ldd --version | head -1
for b in runsvdir runsv sv chpst; do
  req=$(objdump -T "/usr/bin/$b" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'GLIBC_[0-9.]*' | sort -Vu | tail -1 || true)
  printf '%s_required_glibc=%s\n' "$b" "${req:-none}"
done

input.__tool_use_purpose: Create runit stage 1 to materialize writable runtime service directories from read-only golden definitions.
input.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
exec 2>&1

PATH=/opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
SVDIR=/run/runit/service
export SVDIR

install -d -m 0755 /run/runit "$SVDIR"
rm -rf "$SVDIR"/*
for definition in /etc/runit/sv/*; do
    [ -f "$definition/run" ] || continue
    service=${definition##*/}
    runtime=$SVDIR/$service
    install -d -m 0755 "$runtime"
    ln -s "$definition/run" "$runtime/run"
    [ ! -f "$definition/finish" ] || ln -s "$definition/finish" "$runtime/finish"
    [ ! -e "$definition/down" ] || : >"$runtime/down"
done
exit 0

input.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
exec 2>&1

EMQX_HOME=/opt/emqx-5.8.4-native
latest=$(find "$EMQX_HOME/data/configs" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'vm.*.args' -printf '%T@ %p\n' |
    sort -nr | sed -n '1s/^[^ ]* //p')
[ -n "$latest" ] || { echo 'missing persisted EMQX vm arguments' >&2; exit 1; }
EMQX_NODE_COOKIE=$(awk '$1 == "-setcookie" { print $2; exit }' "$latest")
[ -n "$EMQX_NODE_COOKIE" ] || { echo 'missing EMQX node cookie' >&2; exit 1; }
export EMQX_NODE_COOKIE
export EMQX_NODE_NAME=emqx@127.0.0.1
export EMQX_LOG__CONSOLE_HANDLER__ENABLE=true
cd "$EMQX_HOME"
exec "$EMQX_HOME/bin/emqx" foreground

set -eu
exec 2>&1

NAME=netmaker
ADDR=unix:path=/run/opdbus/session-bus.sock
BUS_NAME=org.opdbus.v1.plugins
OBJECT=/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus
INTERFACE=org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1
CURL=/usr/bin/curl
JQ=/usr/bin/jq
BUSCTL=/usr/bin/busctl
SOCKET=/var/lib/incus/unix.socket

wait_dep() {
    dep=$1
    sv start "$dep" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    waited=0
    until sv check "$dep" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        [ "$waited" -lt 120 ] || { echo "dependency $dep not ready" >&2; exit 1; }
        sleep 1
        waited=$((waited + 1))
    done
}

state() {
    "$CURL" --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCKET" \
        "http://localhost/1.0/instances/$NAME/state" 2>/dev/null |
        "$JQ" -r '.metadata.status // "Missing"' 2>/dev/null || printf 'Missing\n'
}

call_incus() {
    method=$1
    payload=$2
    "$BUSCTL" --address="$ADDR" call "$BUS_NAME" "$OBJECT" "$INTERFACE" \
        Call ss "$method" "$payload" >/dev/null
}

stop_instance() {
    [ "$(state)" != Running ] ||
        call_incus stop_instance "{\"name\":\"$NAME\",\"force\":false}" || true
}
trap 'stop_instance; exit 0' HUP INT TERM

wait_dep incusd
wait_dep op-grpc-bridge
[ -S "$SOCKET" ] || { echo "missing Incus API socket $SOCKET" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ "$(state)" != Running ]; then
    call_incus start_instance "{\"name\":\"$NAME\"}"
fi
waited=0
while [ "$(state)" != Running ]; do
    [ "$waited" -lt 120 ] || { echo "$NAME failed to reach Running" >&2; exit 1; }
    sleep 1
    waited=$((waited + 1))
done
echo "$NAME is Running under audited Incus D-Bus lifecycle"

while [ "$(state)" = Running ]; do sleep 5; done
echo "$NAME left Running; retrying" >&2
exit 1

input.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
exec 2>&1

OLD_NAME=${OLD_NAME:-NetMaker}
NEW_NAME=${NEW_NAME:-netmaker}
GOLDEN=${OPDBUS_GOLDEN:-/opt/op-dbus/golden}
BASELINE_DIR=${NETMAKER_BASELINE_DIR:?set NETMAKER_BASELINE_DIR to the captured 0700 baseline}
RUNTIME_DIR=/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker
ENV_OUT=/etc/default/opdbus-netmk
ADDR=unix:path=/run/opdbus/session-bus.sock
BUS_NAME=org.opdbus.v1.plugins
OBJECT=/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus
INTERFACE=org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1
SOCKET=/var/lib/incus/unix.socket
SNAPSHOT=${NETMAKER_SNAPSHOT:-pre-runit-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}
MUTATED=0
RENAMED=0
SUCCESS=0

log() { printf '[netmaker-runit-migrate] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

state() {
    name=$1
    /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCKET" \
        "http://localhost/1.0/instances/$name/state" 2>/dev/null |
        /usr/bin/jq -r '.metadata.status // "Missing"' 2>/dev/null || printf 'Missing\n'
}

pid_of() {
    name=$1
    /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCKET" \
        "http://localhost/1.0/instances/$name/state" |
        /usr/bin/jq -r '.metadata.pid // 0'
}

call_incus() {
    method=$1
    payload=$2
    /usr/bin/busctl --address="$ADDR" call "$BUS_NAME" "$OBJECT" "$INTERFACE" \
        Call ss "$method" "$payload" >/dev/null
}

payload() {
    /usr/bin/jq -cn "$@"
}

set_config() {
    name=$1 key=$2 value=$3
    call_incus set_instance_config "$(payload --arg name "$name" --arg key "$key" --arg value "$value" \
        '{name:$name,key:$key,value:$value}')"
}

unset_config() {
    name=$1 key=$2
    call_incus set_instance_config "$(payload --arg name "$name" --arg key "$key" \
        '{name:$name,key:$key,value:null}')"
}

add_disk() {
    name=$1 device_name=$2 source=$3 target=$4 readonly=$5 shift=$6
    call_incus add_device "$(payload \
        --arg instance "$name" --arg device "$device_name" \
        --arg source "$source" --arg path "$target" \
        --argjson readonly "$readonly" --argjson shift "$shift" \
        '{instance_name:$instance,device_name:$device,device:{type:"disk",source:$source,path:$path,readonly:$readonly,required:true,shift:$shift}}')"
}

remove_device() {
    name=$1 device_name=$2
    call_incus remove_device "$(payload --arg instance "$name" --arg device "$device_name" \
        '{instance_name:$instance,device_name:$device}')" || true
}

wait_state() {
    name=$1 expected=$2 limit=$3
    waited=0
    while [ "$(state "$name")" != "$expected" ]; do
        [ "$waited" -lt "$limit" ] || return 1
        sleep 1
        waited=$((waited + 1))
    done
}

rollback() {
    [ "$MUTATED" -eq 1 ] || return 0
    log 'rolling back container identity, init, and feature devices'
    current=$OLD_NAME
    if [ "$RENAMED" -eq 1 ]; then current=$NEW_NAME; fi
    if [ "$(state "$current")" = Running ]; then
        call_incus stop_instance "$(payload --arg name "$current" '{name:$name,force:true}')" || true
        wait_state "$current" Stopped 60 || true
    fi
    unset_config "$current" raw.lxc || true
    for device in opdbus-netmaker-runtime opdbus-netmaker-adapter opdbus-netmaker-sv opdbus-netmaker-runit-etc opdbus-netmaker-runit-root; do
        remove_device "$current" "$device"
    done
    set_config "$current" boot.autostart true || true
    if [ "$RENAMED" -eq 1 ]; then
        call_incus rename_instance "$(payload --arg name "$NEW_NAME" --arg new_name "$OLD_NAME" \
            '{name:$name,new_name:$new_name}')" || true
        RENAMED=0
    fi
    if [ -f "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" ]; then
        install -m 0755 "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run
    fi
    call_incus start_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" '{name:$name}')" || true
    wait_state "$OLD_NAME" Running 120 || true
    sv down incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    log 'rollback attempted; inspect Incus state and baseline before retrying'
}

finish() {
    rc=$?
    if [ "$SUCCESS" -ne 1 ]; then rollback; fi
    exit "$rc"
}
trap finish EXIT HUP INT TERM

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || die 'must run as root'
[ -S "$SOCKET" ] || die "missing Incus socket $SOCKET"
[ -S /run/opdbus/session-bus.sock ] || die 'missing opdbus session bus'
[ "$(state "$OLD_NAME")" = Running ] || die "$OLD_NAME is not Running"
[ "$(state "$NEW_NAME")" = Missing ] || die "$NEW_NAME already exists"
for path in \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/runit" \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit/1" \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" \
    "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run"; do
    [ -e "$path" ] || die "missing golden artifact $path"
done

OLD_PID=$(pid_of "$OLD_NAME")
[ "$OLD_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'old container has no init PID'
LISTEN_PORT=$(jq -r '.listenport // 0' "/proc/$OLD_PID/root/etc/netclient/netclient.json")
case "$LISTEN_PORT" in ''|0|*[!0-9]*) die 'no captured netclient listen port' ;; esac
BASELINE_HTTP=$(curl --silent --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/server/health || true)
[ "$BASELINE_HTTP" != 000 ] || die 'baseline Netmaker API listener is unreachable'
install -d -m 0755 /etc/default
printf 'NETMK_PEER_PORTS=%s\n' "$LISTEN_PORT" | install -m 0644 /dev/stdin "$ENV_OUT"
install -d -m 0770 "$RUNTIME_DIR"
if [ ! -f "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" ]; then
    install -m 0600 /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before"
fi
printf '%s\n' "$SNAPSHOT" >"$BASELINE_DIR/runit-migration-snapshot"

log "creating rollback snapshot $OLD_NAME/$SNAPSHOT"
call_incus snapshot_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg snapshot "$SNAPSHOT" \
    '{name:$name,snapshot_name:$snapshot}')"

log 'holding the legacy host supervisor down during rename'
sv down incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
log "stopping $OLD_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus stop_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" '{name:$name,force:false}')"
MUTATED=1
wait_state "$OLD_NAME" Stopped 120 || die "$OLD_NAME did not stop"

log "renaming $OLD_NAME to $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus rename_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg new_name "$NEW_NAME" \
    '{name:$name,new_name:$new_name}')"
RENAMED=1
[ "$(state "$NEW_NAME")" = Stopped ] || die 'renamed instance is not Stopped'

log 'attaching immutable golden runit artifacts and writable runtime directory'
set_config "$NEW_NAME" boot.autostart false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-root \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit" /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-etc \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit" /etc/runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-sv \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" /usr/bin/sv true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-adapter \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" /usr/bin/op-grpc-adapters true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runtime \
    "$RUNTIME_DIR" /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker false true
set_config "$NEW_NAME" raw.lxc 'lxc.init.cmd = /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit/bin/runit'

install -m 0755 "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run" /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run
log "starting $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus start_instance "$(payload --arg name "$NEW_NAME" '{name:$name}')"
wait_state "$NEW_NAME" Running 120 || die "$NEW_NAME did not start"
NEW_PID=$(pid_of "$NEW_NAME")
[ "$NEW_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'new container has no init PID'
INIT=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -m -p -- ps -p 1 -o comm= | tr -d ' ')
[ "$INIT" = runit ] || die "PID 1 is '$INIT', expected runit"

log 'waiting for preserved service listeners'
waited=0
while :; do
    listeners=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -n -- ss -lntH 2>/dev/null || true)
    ready=1
    for port in 8081 8083 1883 3000 9090 9100; do
        printf '%s\n' "$listeners" | grep -Eq "[:.]$port[[:space:]]" || ready=0
    done
    [ "$ready" -eq 1 ] && break
    [ "$waited" -lt 180 ] || die 'preserved service listeners did not recover'
    sleep 2
    waited=$((waited + 2))
done
CURRENT_HTTP=$(curl --silent --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/server/health || true)
[ "$CURRENT_HTTP" = "$BASELINE_HTTP" ] ||
    die "Netmaker API baseline changed ($BASELINE_HTTP -> $CURRENT_HTTP)"

sv up incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null
sleep 2
sv check incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$NEW_PID" >"$BASELINE_DIR/runit-migration-new-pid"
SUCCESS=1
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
log "$NEW_NAME is running with runit PID 1; baseline HTTP status $CURRENT_HTTP preserved"

    rc=$?
    if [ "$SUCCESS" -ne 1 ]; then rollback; fi

    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit/1" \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" \

[ "$OLD_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'old container has no init PID'

case "$LISTEN_PORT" in ''|0|*[!0-9]*) die 'no captured netclient listen port' ;; esac

[ "$BASELINE_HTTP" != 000 ] || die 'baseline Netmaker API listener is unreachable'
install -d -m 0755 /etc/default
printf 'NETMK_PEER_PORTS=%s\n' "$LISTEN_PORT" | install -m 0644 /dev/stdin "$ENV_OUT"
install -d -m 0770 "$RUNTIME_DIR"
if [ ! -f "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" ]; then
    install -m 0600 /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before"
fi

log "creating rollback snapshot $OLD_NAME/$SNAPSHOT"
call_incus snapshot_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg snapshot "$SNAPSHOT" \
    '{name:$name,snapshot_name:$snapshot}')"

log 'holding the legacy host supervisor down during rename'
sv down incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
log "stopping $OLD_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus stop_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" '{name:$name,force:false}')"
MUTATED=1
wait_state "$OLD_NAME" Stopped 120 || die "$OLD_NAME did not stop"

log "renaming $OLD_NAME to $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus rename_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg new_name "$NEW_NAME" \
    '{name:$name,new_name:$new_name}')"
RENAMED=1
[ "$(state "$NEW_NAME")" = Stopped ] || die 'renamed instance is not Stopped'

log 'attaching immutable golden runit artifacts and writable runtime directory'
set_config "$NEW_NAME" boot.autostart false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-root \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit" /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-etc \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit" /etc/runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-sv \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" /usr/bin/sv true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-adapter \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" /usr/bin/op-grpc-adapters true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runtime \
    "$RUNTIME_DIR" /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker false true
set_config "$NEW_NAME" raw.lxc 'lxc.init.cmd = /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit/bin/runit'

install -m 0755 "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run" /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run
log "starting $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus start_instance "$(payload --arg name "$NEW_NAME" '{name:$name}')"
wait_state "$NEW_NAME" Running 120 || die "$NEW_NAME did not start"
NEW_PID=$(pid_of "$NEW_NAME")
[ "$NEW_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'new container has no init PID'
INIT=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -m -p -- ps -p 1 -o comm= | tr -d ' ')
[ "$INIT" = runit ] || die "PID 1 is '$INIT', expected runit"

log 'waiting for preserved service listeners'
waited=0
while :; do
    listeners=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -n -- ss -lntH 2>/dev/null || true)
    ready=1
    for port in 8081 8083 1883 3000 9090 9100; do
        printf '%s\n' "$listeners" | grep -Eq "[:.]$port[[:space:]]" || ready=0
    done
    [ "$ready" -eq 1 ] && break
    [ "$waited" -lt 180 ] || die 'preserved service listeners did not recover'
    sleep 2
    waited=$((waited + 2))
done

[ "$CURRENT_HTTP" = "$BASELINE_HTTP" ] ||
    die "Netmaker API baseline changed ($BASELINE_HTTP -> $CURRENT_HTTP)"

sleep 2
sv check incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$NEW_PID" >"$BASELINE_DIR/runit-migration-new-pid"
SUCCESS=1
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
log "$NEW_NAME is running with runit PID 1; baseline HTTP status $CURRENT_HTTP preserved"

Inspect: crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/incus.rs; crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/mutation_engine.rs; deploy/runit/migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh; deploy/runit/incus-ct-netmaker/run; deploy/runit/build-golden.sh; deploy/containers/netmaker-runit/**; and the six netmk runit scripts. input.task: Safety-review the authorized full NetMaker migration from systemd PID1 to lowercase runit PID1 before production deployment.

content.data:
Pipeline completed: 1 stages finished.

## review

## NetMaker Runit Migration Review — BLOCKER REPORT

### BLOCKERS

**BLOCKER 1: `cognitive_mcp.rs` uses stale s6 D-Bus interface for reload**

- **File:** `crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/cognitive_mcp.rs`, lines 148–149
- **Issue:** Calls `opdbus.v1.S6.Systemctl` at path `/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/s6/systemctl` instead of `org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl` at `/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/runit/systemctl`. This is a stale s6 lifecycle reference that violates the "no s6 lifecycle" requirement.
- **Impact:** Not a *migration-blocking* issue for NetMaker itself (this code path is cognitive_mcp reload, not netmaker). However, it is a live contract violation of the host policy. The `op-s6-systemctl` binary does register both names (legacy alias), so this works at runtime but violates the "treat s6 as stale" mandate.
- **Fix:** Change interface/path to `org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl` / `/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/runit/systemctl`.
- **Severity for cutover:** LOW — does not block NetMaker migration specifically.

**BLOCKER 2: Migration script rollback does NOT restore the Incus snapshot**

- **File:** `deploy/runit/migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh`, `rollback()` function (lines 85–108)
- **Issue:** The rollback creates a snapshot at line 149 (`call_incus snapshot_instance ...`) but the `rollback()` function only:
  1. Stops the container
  2. Unsets `raw.lxc`
  3. Removes feature devices
  4. Re-enables `boot.autostart`
  5. Renames back
  6. Starts the old container

  It never calls `incus snapshot restore` to revert the container filesystem to its pre-mutation state. If the container's internal state was corrupted (e.g., the runit stage 1 partially overwrote files), the "rollback" would start a broken container.
- **Impact:** Partial rollback — container identity/config is restored but filesystem damage persists.
- **Fix:** Add after the rename-back step: `call_incus restore_snapshot "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg snapshot "$SNAPSHOT" '{name:$name,snapshot_name:$snapshot}')"` — but `restore_snapshot` is not currently wired in `dispatch_incus_method`. Either wire it or use the Incus REST API directly via curl.
- **Severity for cutover:** MEDIUM — rollback is incomplete but the container filesystem should be fine since all runit artifacts are bind-mounted read-only (they overlay, not overwrite). The snapshot is still a manual escape hatch (`incus snapshot restore netmaker pre-runit-*`).

**BLOCKER 3: `build-golden.sh` does NOT explicitly install `incus-ct-netmaker/run` into the golden artifact path the migration expects**

- **File:** `deploy/runit/build-golden.sh`, lines 127–140 (the runit sv staging loop)
- **File:** `deploy/runit/migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh`, line 143 (`$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run`)
- **Issue:** The migration script checks `[ -e "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run" ]` as a precondition. `build-golden.sh`'s loop iterates `"$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/` and stages anything with a `run` file. Since `deploy/runit/incus-ct-netmaker/run` exists, this DOES work — the loop captures it automatically. **NOT A BLOCKER upon closer inspection.**
- **Severity:** NONE — the loop correctly captures it.

---

### PASS CRITERIA VERIFICATION

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| No systemctl/s6 lifecycle in migration scripts | ✅ PASS | grep of all deploy/runit/*netm* scripts returns zero hits for systemctl/s6-rc/s6-svc/service6 |
| No systemctl/s6 in container scripts | ✅ PASS | grep of deploy/containers/netmaker-runit returns zero hits |
| Incus mutations through busctl/D-Bus | ✅ PASS | migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh uses `busctl --address=... call` for all Incus operations; incus-ct-netmaker/run uses same pattern |
| Exact scoped device/config ownership | ✅ PASS | `reconcile_device` does remove+add of single device; `set_instance_config` does get-modify-put of single key; migration only touches its own named devices (opdbus-netmaker-*) |
| Snapshot before stop | ✅ PASS | Line 149-150: snapshot created, then stop at line 153 |

- **Impact:** Not a *migration-blocking* issue for NetMaker itself (this code path is cognitive_mcp reload, not netmaker). However, it is a live contract violation of the host policy. The `op-s6-systemctl` binary does register both names (legacy alias), so this works at runtime but violates the "treat s6 as stale" mandate.
- **Fix:** Change interface/path to `org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl` / `/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/runit/systemctl`.
- **Severity for cutover:** LOW — does not block NetMaker migration specifically.

**BLOCKER 2: Migration script rollback does NOT restore the Incus snapshot**

- **File:** `deploy/runit/migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh`, `rollback()` function (lines 85–108)

  4. Re-enables `boot.autostart`

Immutable wgcf config hash/table/mark remained unchanged during inventory. No production mutation was performed.

data.summary:
## OBJECTIVE

Complete and live-activate Phase 1 of the Netclient container-netns specification in `/srv/git/odbus`, including an explicitly authorized migration of the production Incus `NetMaker` container to lowercase `netmaker` with runit as PID 1, then activate the host Phase 1 runit graph while preserving immutable `wgcf-egress` state and never triggering Phase 2.

Target behavior:

- Attach `netmaker` to `ovsbr0` via OVS internal port `netmk`.
- Configure `10.200.1.1/30`, gateway `10.200.1.2`.
- Route through xray, then host `svc0`, mandatory mark `0x51821`, priority `10518` lookup table `51820`, and priority `10519` blackhole.
- Permit only ARP and approved WireGuard UDP destination ports.
- NAT only through `wgcf-egress`, never `pub0`.
- Run authenticated Netmaker adapter on UDS and expose host loopback `127.0.0.1:50061`.
- Use native OVSDB/rtnetlink/OF1.3 and audited Incus D-Bus paths.
- Preserve rollback and immutable wgcf boundaries.

## USER GUIDANCE

- Runit only. Do not introduce s6, `service6`, or systemd lifecycle assumptions.
- User explicitly authorized live activation by choosing option `3`.
- User later explicitly authorized option `2`: full replacement/migration of `NetMaker` to lowercase `netmaker` with runit PID 1.
- Container and application lifecycle mutations must use D-Bus through `busctl`.
- Do not manage Incus lifecycle with raw `incus` CLI.
- Deploy via the btrfs golden path; do not hand-copy binaries.
- Preserve unrelated working-tree changes.
- Do not commit unless explicitly requested.
- `wgcf-egress` remains immutable:
  - Never edit its config.
  - Never create/delete/up/down/restart it or its owner.
  - Never change mark `0x51820`.
  - Never mutate routes in table `51820`.
- No `pub0` NAT.
- OpenFlow uses UDP destination ports, never source-port allows.
- Phase 2 / `xray0` remains separately gated and must not run.
- User requested all long builds run as detached background processes.
- User emphasized there is no Python in the codebase. No Python source was added. One inline `python3` diagnostic had previously been used only to compare environment equality; user objected. Do not invoke Python again. Use Rust, POSIX shell, and native tools only.
- Required completion note:
  `[STEERING steer-6f453cc0161a4e469a7c3879f634d3c7: Removed stale s6 assumptions and made the specification runit-only.]`

## COMPLETED

### Original Phase 1 implementation

Previously completed and validated:

- Typed OCI attachment reconciliation.
- Native Incus PID lookup.
- Namespace-safe rtnetlink operations.
- Exact scoped route and policy rule management.
- Strict cookie-aware OpenFlow deletion.
- Authoritative OF1.3 `DumpSwitchFlows`.
- Authenticated dedicated Netmaker adapter endpoint.
- Native `op-netmk-reconcile` helper.
- Six inactive runit service definitions.
- Live WireGuard listen/peer endpoint port discovery.
- Comprehensive Rust tests and independent review with `NO_BLOCKERS`.

### Explicit live preflight

Initial activation preflight found `wgcf-egress` absent and halted without mutation. User later brought it up.

Current verified wgcf state:

- Interface `wgcf-egress` UP.
- FwMark exactly `0x51820`.
- Recent handshake.
- Table `51820` has `default dev wgcf-egress`.
- Config SHA-256 unchanged:
  `08ce0fca11cfee95adfece0164c8d7a196a750b9fe937a606defdcf2bfdeb998`
- No owning runit service was found; treat it as externally maintained.
- No feature mutation has touched wgcf.

### Production NetMaker inventory

Secure baseline captured at:

```text
/tmp/opdbus-netmk-baseline-20260802T014448Z
```

Mode is `0700`.

Observed production state:

- Incus instance is case-sensitive `NetMaker`.
- Lowercase `netmaker` returns 404.
- PID 1 is systemd.
- Existing processes include:
  - EMQX
  - Netmaker API
  - Grafana
  - Prometheus
  - rust-network-mgr
  - cron
  - systemd-resolved
  - dbus-daemon
  - rsyslog
- Existing listeners include:
  - Netmaker API `8081`
  - EMQX `1883`, `8083`, `8084`, `8883`, `18083`
  - Grafana `3000`
  - Prometheus `9090`
  - rust-network-mgr `9100`
- Existing Netclient binary:
  `/usr/local/bin/netclient`
- Netclient config exists but:
  - `nodes.json` empty
  - `netclient list` reports `no such network`
  - No WireGuard interface/peer/handshake exists
  - Configured `listenport=51822`
- Persistent Netmaker environment:
  `/etc/netmaker/netmaker.env`
  - mode `0600`
  - Matches running process values for license, master key, tenant, API, database, and server settings.
- Authenticated Netmaker API health currently returns:
  `403 invalid license: failed to validate license key: no result found`
- This license/enrollment state remains an external blocker for final join/handshake acceptance, but the infrastructure migration control path can be built/staged.

### Authorized runit migration implementation

Implemented a full migration control path.

#### Incus plugin changes

`crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/incus.rs` now includes:

- Case-insensitive fallback resolving exactly one legacy spelling (`NetMaker` → `netmaker`) while rejecting ambiguity.
- Native methods:
  - `create_snapshot`
  - `restore_snapshot`
  - `set_instance_running`
  - `rename_instance`
  - `set_instance_config`
  - `reconcile_device`
  - `remove_device`
- Typed inputs:
  - `RenameInstanceInput`
  - `SetInstanceConfigInput`
  - `RestoreSnapshotInput`
- Schema methods:
  - `snapshot_instance`
  - `restore_snapshot`
  - `start_instance`
  - `stop_instance`
  - `restart_instance`
  - `rename_instance`
  - `set_instance_config`
  - `add_device`
  - `remove_device`
  - `update_device`

A unit test pins that all migration methods appear in the schema.

#### Mutation dispatcher

`crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/mutation_engine.rs` now dispatches plugin `"incus"` to a real `dispatch_incus_method` rather than falling through to the generic echo behavior.

Implemented runtime dispatch for:

- snapshot
- restore snapshot
- start
- stop
- restart
- rename
- set config
- add/update/remove exact device

All calls remain audited through the mutation engine event chain.

#### Runit PID-1 tree

Created under:

```text
deploy/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit/
```

Includes stages:

- `1`: materializes writable runtime service directories under `/run/runit/service`.
- `2`: execs `runsvdir -P`.
- `3`: bounded shutdown using `sv`.

Container services:

- `dbus`
- `resolved`
- `cron`
- `rsyslog`
- `emqx`
- `netmaker`
- `grafana`
- `prometheus`
- `rust-network-mgr`
- `op-grpc-adapters`
- `netclient`

`netclient/down` keeps Netclient stopped until host policy/OpenFlow/adapter gates are ready.

EMQX cookie is derived from persisted EMQX runtime args instead of being embedded in source.

Netmaker sources existing `/etc/netmaker/netmaker.env`.

Adapter exports:

- `NETMAKER_MASTER_KEY`
- `ADAPTERS_SOCKET`
- `SVDIR=/run/runit/service`

#### Golden staging

`deploy/runit/build-golden.sh` now:

- Accepts optional `RELEASE_DIR`.

Json.description: Execute the authorized NetMaker runit migration and Phase 1 activation in strict prerequisite order.
context: Read-only live preflight completed with no mutation. Hard prerequisite failed: host has no wgcf-egress interface, no table-51820 routes, no underlay mark 0x51820, and no wgcf-egress owning runit definition; only WireGuard interface 3tched exists with fwmark off. Config hash was captured as 08ce0fca11cfee95adfece0164c8d7a196a750b9fe937a606defdcf2bfdeb998, but immutable policy prohibits creating/starting/repairing wgcf state. Additional blocker: live Incus instance is case-sensitive `NetMaker` (Running), while all typed reconciliation and installed incus-ct-netmaker service target lowercase `netmaker`; native API for lowercase returns 404. Adapter host runtime directory/socket and op-netmk-reconcile/op-grpc-adapters installed binaries are absent. Packaging mismatch discovered: build-golden installs host binaries to /usr/local/bin while new host runit definitions default helper to /usr/bin. Feature policy rules/chains were absent before activation. No live state was changed and no build/install/enable/start was attempted after the gate failure.

Captured secure read-only rollback inventory at /tmp/opdbus-netmk-baseline-20260802T014448Z (0700). NetMaker PID 4864 uses systemd PID1; running services/listeners include EMQX, Netmaker API, Grafana, Prometheus, rust-network-mgr, cron, resolved, dbus, and rsyslog. Persistent /etc/netmaker/netmaker.env exists mode 0600 and exactly reproduces running LICENSE_KEY, MASTER_KEY, tenant, and server settings without exposing values. Authenticated /api/server/health returns pre-existing HTTP 403 `invalid license: failed to validate license key: no result found`; API listener is reachable. Netclient binary/config exists but daemon is not running, nodes.json is empty, `netclient list` reports `no such network`, no WireGuard interface/peer/handshake exists, and only configured local listenport 51822 can serve as first-boot fallback. Therefore Phase 1's authenticated healthy backend, live peer-port discovery, join, and handshake acceptance gates cannot pass. Immutable wgcf config hash/table/mark remained unchanged during inventory. No production mutation was performed.

Implemented guarded runit migration control path. Incus plugin now resolves a single case-insensitive legacy name, exposes native snapshot/restore/start/stop/restart/rename/single-config/exact-device operations, and mutation_engine dispatches those D-Bus methods instead of echoing. Added schema test pinning all migration methods (3 Incus tests passed). Added btrfs-golden NetMaker runit PID1 tree preserving dbus, resolved, cron, rsyslog, EMQX, Netmaker, Grafana, Prometheus, rust-network-mgr; adapter auto-starts and netclient is held down. Added audited host incus-ct-netmaker runit lifecycle, exact helper paths, first-boot port env support, guarded migration script with snapshot-before-stop and automatic filesystem/config/name rollback. build-golden dry-run passed and stages all container assets. cargo check op-plugins/op-grpc-bridge passed; shell syntax and diff checks passed. Independent review found no hard blockers; its snapshot-restore recommendation was implemented and revalidated. No live production state was changed.

Session management
Kiro CLI automatically saves all chat sessions on every conversation turn. You can resume from any previous chat session at any time.

From the command line
bash

# Resume the most recent chat session
kiro-cli chat --resume

# Interactively pick a chat session to resume
kiro-cli chat --resume-picker

# List all saved chat sessions for the current directory
kiro-cli chat --list-sessions

# Delete a saved chat session

From within a chat session
Use the /chat command to manage sessions:

bash

# Start a fresh conversation (saves current session automatically)
/chat new

# Start a fresh conversation with an initial prompt
/chat new <PROMPT>

# Resume a chat session (interactive selector)
/chat resume

# Save current session to a file
/chat save <FILE_PATH>

# Load a session from a file
/chat load <FILE_PATH>
The .json extension is optional when loading - Kiro will try both with and without the extension.

Custom session storage
You can use custom scripts to control where chat sessions are saved to and loaded from. This allows you to store sessions in version control systems, cloud storage, databases, or any custom location.

# Save session via custom script (receives JSON via stdin)
/chat save-via-script <SCRIPT_PATH>

# Load session via custom script (outputs JSON to stdout)
/chat load-via-script <SCRIPT_PATH>
Tips:

Session IDs are UUIDs that uniquely identify each chat session
Sessions are stored per directory, so each project has its own set of sessions

export KIRO_LOG_NO_COLOR=true
